author: JKawesome
body:
This player had been extremely rude to me when we're in-game together, calling me a "f***ing hacker" and a "donor noob" a lot. He has been punished for his rudeness and language, however, he/she doesn't learn, and instead brags about how many infractions they have received. As I'm writing this, this player has a total of 22 infractions, most of them being chat warnings and kicks, all from a very short timespan. http://avicus.net/hazzandolly?tab=infractions

Please do something about this, it's really frustrating, and ruins my gameplay experience, being called a noob every time I log on. Thanks.
